title: isoloma incanum
intro: Isoloma incanum, commonly known as the "New Zealand spleenwort," is a species of fern native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Isoloma incanum include wound healing, skin conditions, and anti-bacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
